# Pargat Singh Named Punjab Congress Chief

![Former Punjab Congress chief Amarinder Singh Raja Warring standing alongside newly appointed president Pargat Singh.](https://i0.wp.com/rmnnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Amarinder-Pargat-Punjab-Congress.jpeg?resize=1110%2C623&ssl=1)

# **Hockey Legend Pargat Singh Appointed Punjab Congress Chief to Unify Party Ahead of 2027 Assembly Elections**

**The Indian National Congress has appointed former hockey captain and multi-term MLA Pargat Singh as the new president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee. The decision follows the resignation of Amarinder Singh Raja Warring and seeks to bring structural stability and unity amid ongoing internal factionalism. By maintaining Jat Sikh leadership while working alongside key Dalit and Hindu leaders, the party aims to build a cohesive organization for the 2027 Punjab Assembly election.**

***RMN News Punjab Desk***  
***New Delhi | October 3, 2026***

#### **Pargat Singh Takes Helm of Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee**

In a strategic move designed to heal internal rifts and fortify its organizational apparatus, the Indian National Congress High Command has appointed sports icon and multi-term MLA Pargat Singh as the president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee (PPCC). The decision was formally approved by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge, [**senior leader Rahul Gandhi**](https://rmnnews.com/rahul-gandhi-barking-dog-indian-politics/), and AICC Punjab in-charge Sachin Pilot.

Pargat Singh succeeds Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, who [**tendered his resignation**](https://rmnnews.com/2026/10/02/punjab-congress-turmoil-amarinder-warring-resigns-rahul-gandhi/) following months of persistent organizational friction and leadership disputes within the state unit. The appointment comes at a critical juncture as political parties across Punjab begin consolidating their grassroots machinery for the 2027 Punjab Assembly election.

#### **Leadership Transition and Internal Harmony**

The leadership change follows an extended period of internal restlessness within the state congress unit. Raja Warring, who had served as state unit chief for nearly four and a half years after taking over from [**Navjot Singh Sidhu**](https://rmnnews.com/2025/12/07/sidhus-cm-candidate-demand-sets-stage-for-punjab-political-comeback-amidst-internal-strife-and-critical-scrutiny/) in 2022, faced growing pressure from competing internal groups, notably a faction associated with former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi.

To address escalating discord, the party leadership initiated structural shifts in September by appointing former Rajasthan Deputy Chief Minister Sachin Pilot as the central in-charge for Punjab, replacing Bhupesh Baghel. Subsequent efforts to foster coordination saw leaders share public platforms, culminating in Warring stepping down to pave the way for a fresh organizational start.

Former Chief Minister Charanjit Singh Channi also welcomed the decision of the Congress High Command, expressing confidence in Pargat Singh’s leadership.
